title: Immunization Services Pharmacist Chart — Age, Attestation and Repeat-Course Thresholds by Vaccination
content:
Kestrel pharmacists give each Immunization Services vaccination only within the age band shown below, and the chart also fixes, for each vaccination, the age below which a qualifying risk condition must be attested, the age below which a parent or legal guardian signs the consent, whether a patient may receive another course after completing one, the least number of days since the last dose of a previous course, and whether a dose documented by another provider counts toward the course. Ages are whole years of age.

## Chart

| Vaccination | Youngest age on the dose date | Oldest age on the dose date | Risk condition attested below age | Guardian signs consent below age | Another course after a completed one | Days since last dose of previous course | Dose documented by another provider counts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | 3 | 120 | 0 (never required) | 18 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | 65 | 120 | 0 (never required) | 18 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | 5 | 120 | 0 (never required) | 18 | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | 60 | 120 | 75 | 18 | No | 0 | Yes |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | 19 | 120 | 50 | 18 | No | 0 | Yes |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | 19 | 120 | 50 | 18 | No | 0 | Yes |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | 18 | 120 | 0 (never required) | 18 | No | 0 | Yes |

## Reading the columns

- **Youngest and oldest age.** The patient's age in whole years on the dose date is at least the youngest age and no more than the oldest age.
- **Risk condition attested below age.** Below this age the patient attests a qualifying risk condition for the vaccination. A figure of 0 means the attestation is never required for that vaccination.
- **Guardian signs consent below age.** Below this age a parent or legal guardian signs the screening and consent form.
- **Another course after a completed one.** "Yes" means the patient may receive another course of the vaccination after completing one; "No" means the patient may not.
- **Days since last dose of previous course.** The least number of calendar days from the last dose of the previous course of the same vaccination. A figure of 0 means the season rule governs instead of a day count.
- **Dose documented by another provider counts.** "Yes" means a dose documented by another provider counts toward the course.

## Hypothetical readings of the chart

- A hypothetical patient aged 64 on the dose date is within the band for the RSV Older Adult Vaccination (60 to 120) and is below 75, so the risk-condition column applies to that patient; a hypothetical patient aged 75 is not below 75, so it does not.
- A hypothetical patient aged 49 falls below 50 for the Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination and the Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series; at 50 the patient is no longer below that age.
- A hypothetical patient aged 17 is below 18 for every vaccination in the guardian column; at 18 the patient is not.
- For the COVID-19 Updated Vaccination the chart shows 60 days since the last dose of the previous course; for every other vaccination it shows 0.
